title: 第二章 二周目勇者的重来人生
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你你你，你说你是...”伊尔莎不敢置信的问道。

“对啊，所以路过看到你这么可爱的女孩子，肯定会出手相救啊，这是本能。”亚枫点着头说道，仿佛这是什么世界运行的基本原理一样。

“你，你...”

伊尔莎理解这个词的意思，就是那种存在于人类王国的，专门对幼态女孩起歹念的，罪大恶极的人。

而眼前这个实力高强的大魔法师，居然就这么大大方方的承认了。

直接坦言要对自己出手？

伊尔莎一时间大脑宕机了，

伊尔莎今年已经十八岁了，但作为长寿的魔族，看着也才十二三岁的样子，身体都还尚未发育，含苞待放，身材娇小纤细，已经展现出极为出众的容貌，雪白的长发，白皙细腻的肌肤，脸蛋精致俏丽，眼眸也如同红宝石般灿烂，身后还带着一条细长的尾巴，尾巴的末端是箭头型的倒钩。

简单的说，是个美人胚子。

对历来以健壮丰满为美的魔族根本没人会在意她这种小不点，还有公开批评她这种乳臭未干的小孩根本没资格主持大局，

却吸引了这样的人...

这种人还救了自己，还向他出卖了自己的灵魂。

伊尔莎内心空了一拍，所以，他救自己没其他的目的，就是单纯的想要...

用她满足那变态的癖好？

一股寒意直蹿脑门，已经开始打起了寒颤。

“既然你都问了，那么我们就先聊聊吧，”亚枫清咳一声，严肃的看向她。

“根据之前的约定，我救了你，你今后将归我所有，那么我给你三个选择。”

他对伊尔莎伸出了三根手指，

“一，成为我的奴隶，失去所有的人格和尊严，任我使用，将来出现任何身体功能残缺都与我无关。”

“你...”

如此直白的发言让伊尔莎咬紧牙关，手心冒汗，尾巴也蜷了起来。

他的意思，完全是要把自己当成是**的工具...

她清楚，自己现在已经落到了这位变态大魔法师的手里，未来的日子大概是极为屈辱的地狱。

这种情况，她还能忍耐下去吗...

“二，成为我的女儿，我会给你提供所有衣食住行，如果你想要上学的话我也会送你去，但前提是你得听话，而且以后都要用爸爸来称呼我。”

“欸？”

伊尔莎一愣，这又是什么癖好？玩养成吗？

“三，”亚枫继续说道：

“成为我的妈妈，每天你要给我做饭，打扫卫生，还要出去上班赚钱养我，给我洗澡洗衣服，晚上还得先把我给哄睡着，还得在我难过的时候抱着我哄我安慰我。”

伊尔莎张了张嘴，呆呆的看着他，

此时她已经完全无法理解对方在说什么了。

人类的喜好都这么猎奇的吗？

“选吧，倒数三秒你要是不选我就替你选了啊。”

Page (1/3)

"You, you, you said you were..." Ilsa asked in disbelief.

"Yes, so when I see a cute girl like you passing by, I will definitely come to my rescue. This is instinctive." Yafeng nodded and said, as if this is the basic principle of how the world works.

"You, you..."

Ilsa understands the meaning of this word, which is the kind of person who exists in the human kingdom and specializes in having evil thoughts about childish girls, and is a heinous person.

And the powerful magician in front of him actually admitted it so openly.

Directly admit that he wants to take action against himself?

Ilsa's brain shut down for a moment.

Ilsa is already eighteen years old this year, but as a long-lived demon, she looks like she is only twelve or thirteen years old. Her body has not yet developed, and she is petite and slender. She has already shown an extremely outstanding appearance, with long snow-white hair, fair and delicate skin, a delicate and pretty face, and eyes as bright as rubies. She also has a slender tail behind her, with an arrow-shaped barb at the end.

To put it simply, she is a beautiful woman.

For the demons who have always regarded being strong and plump as their beauty, no one would care about a little kid like her, and publicly criticized a young child like her who was not qualified to take charge of the overall situation.

But it attracts people like this...

This kind of person also saved himself and sold his soul to him.

Ilsa felt empty in her heart, so he had no other purpose in saving her, he just wanted to...

Use her to satisfy that perverted fetish?

A chill rushed to his forehead, and he started to shiver.

"Since you asked, let's talk first," Yafeng coughed and looked at her seriously.

"According to the previous agreement, I saved you and you will belong to me from now on. Then I will give you three choices."

He held out three fingers to Ilsa,

"First, become my slave, lose all personality and dignity, and be at my disposal. Any disability in your body in the future will have nothing to do with me."

"You..."

Such a straightforward statement made Ilsa grit her teeth, her palms became sweaty, and her tail curled up.

What he means is to regard himself as a tool of evil...

She knew that she had now fallen into the hands of this perverted great magician, and the days ahead would probably be an extremely humiliating hell.

Can she endure this situation...

"Two, as my daughter, I will provide you with all the food, clothing, housing and transportation. If you want to go to school, I will also send you there, but the condition is that you must be obedient and you must call me daddy from now on."

"Huh?"

Ilsa was stunned, what kind of hobby is this?Play to develop?

"Three," Yafeng continued:

"Being my mother, you have to cook for me every day, clean the house, go to work to earn money to support me, give me a bath and wash clothes, put me to sleep at night, and hold me and comfort me when I am sad."

Ilsa opened her mouth and looked at him blankly,

At this time, she could no longer understand what the other party was saying.

Are all human beings so curious in their hobbies?

"Choose. If you don't choose in three seconds, I will choose for you."
